name: Immigration counsel (category guide)
summary: Category entry for EP, Tech.Pass, ONE Pass, LTVP common-law, visit-pass extensions, Work Holiday / Training EP, lost-card edge cases, FCF timing, Tuition Grant / NS edge cases, retrenchment STVP asks, and side-income questions — use regulated advisers when HR scripts run out.
body: Most straightforward EP issues are employer-led via MOM. Engage immigration counsel for refusals, complex dependants, common-law LTVP evidence packs, EntrePass / Tech.Pass / ONE Pass conversions, PEP one-shot timing, or PR strategy — not for routine first-pass filing your HR already owns. Short internship and working-holiday paths (Work Holiday Programme, AU/NZ Work & Holiday, Training Employment Pass) are easy to confuse with tourist visit passes — counsel helps when schools sit off MOM’s sample lists or employers invent illegal ‘start first, pass later’ plans. Fair Consideration Framework advertising (≥14 days on MyCareersFuture unless exempt) sits before many EP submissions; counsel helps when ICT exemptions, salary-band mismatches, or debarment risk enter the chat. Short-Term Visit Pass confusion is common: ICA online extensions while waiting for a first pass are not the same as MOM’s post-cancellation STVP — overstaying or JB visa runs are how clean files become messy. After retrenchment, ask HR in writing for the longest STVP on cancel and parallel a contractual benefit / TADM path; counsel helps when DP/LTVP cascade or graduate LTVP timing is non-standard. Lost or stolen pass cards are usually an HR EP eService replacement within one week; counsel helps when repeated losses trigger interviews or when you are stuck overseas without a re-entry letter. Side-income questions (content creation, overseas remote on DP) start from MOM FAQs; counsel helps when your employer’s risk team will not accept a link alone. Male ex-PRs who renounced before NS should get written CMPB clarity before assuming an EP transfer will clear — COMPASS is not a NS waiver. International graduates on MOE Tuition Grant bonds need counsel when liquidated-damages clocks collide with pass cancellation. Foreign spouses leaving abusive sponsors need immigration advice *after* safety (NAVH / PPO) — pass dependency myths should not delay police or Protection Specialist Centres. Death of a main pass holder is an ICA + estate problem, not a Facebook pass conversion.
